about_the_game:
You awake to find yourself locked inside a curious house. Explore your surroundings to find clues and helpful items. Make clever connections to solve the hidden puzzles in each room. Delve into the deeper mystery of this place to uncover it's true meaning.

TRACE: Definitive Edition is a remaster of the popular 2022 webgame TRACE. Praised for its puzzle design and stunning graphics, TRACE: Definitive Edition expands on the original with mind-bending new puzzles, gorgeous new visuals, and a captivating narrative.

UNIQUE PUZZLES

Make clever connections to solve puzzles that put your mental dexterity to the test.

HIGH DEFINITION GRAPHICS

Immerse yourself in a surreal 3D environment in marvelous HD.

A DEEPER MYSTERY

This world isn't what it seems. Witness reflections of a dark past to understand your current predicament.
